name: Coordinator comments reach the assignee through review states
summary: On an open assigned task, unconsumed other-party comments, including coordinator/owner comments and structured review comments, return attention to the assignee across review states, including an integrated remainder. A valid assignee checkpoint or structured response consumes attention; own parent/sub-label progress stays quiet, closed tasks gain none and operator errors remain operator work. Work listings and HTTP next/worker wait share this decision and existing activity selection and stable wait markers; review/lifecycle facts and coordinator-wait trigger groups remain unchanged.
